description:
Coffee brewing assistant with timer, bean management, and tasting notes

Brew Guide is an all-in-one coffee brewing assistant app.
Features include brewing timer with multi-stage guidance, coffee bean inventory management,
brewing notes with ratings and flavor profiles, and cloud sync support.
- Upgrade native apps to local SQLite storage and support offline desktop startup.
- Fix image synchronization and refresh across coffee beans and notes.
- Improve cloud sync responsiveness, backups, and data migration.
- Add switching between brewing and roasting records, with fixes for roasting edits and inventory updates.
- Add date and roaster filters to personal rankings and average roaster ratings.
- Improve desktop settings, tables, and external links.
